tasks.title: Write an Email
tasks.instruction: Write an email. In your email, do the following:
tasks.prompt: You recently stayed at a hotel during a campus visit. While you generally liked the room, there were some issues with the room during your stay. You need to provide feedback to the hotel manager, Ms. Thompson, and suggest improvements. Write an email to Ms. Thompson.
bullets: Describe what you enjoyed about your stay.
Explain the issues you had with the room and stay.
Suggest ways that the hotel could make a guest's stay more peaceful.
tasks.subject: Feedback on Hotel Stay
